name: Realm: ashen volcanic badlands (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic volcanic badland photographed on location like a feature-film still - black basalt and cinder, steam vents, drifting ash and smoke, dark stone forge villages, a low red sun through haze and the orange glow of lava at dusk; any magic is a flicker of ember light
notes: The fire homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/fire/ (set components.realm).
